Provide $5 million annually for NYPD public-safety staffing, support, or associated needs in conjunction with the substation
Status: UNVERIFIED
The cited sources document the terms of the undertaking.
Promised scope: Bally's promised to amend its commitment to provide $5 million annually for NYPD staffing and support, described as for all NYPD associated needs in conjunction with the NYPD substation it would house, within the 45th Precinct public-safety proposal.
Observed scope: Delivery for the promised scope remains unverified.
Evidence gap: The sources do not establish actual performance for the promised scope. Timing to verify: Annual support, but no specific first payment date is cited in the provided excerpts; c7 indicates methodology would be explored upon awarding of a license.

Cited source excerpts (promise, delivery, or context as assessed above):
c1: “A key component of this commitment is our up to $10 million capital contribution towards the construction of a new NYPD substation for the 45th Precinct.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf

c2: “This was outlined in our Community Benefits Agreement, where we initially intended to fund up to $3 million dollars annually for purposes of staffing. Hearing the request from the CAC, we will amend our commitment to provide $5 million dollars annually for the purposes of staffing and support.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf

c3: “The Board notes that Bally’s agreed to increase this amount from $3 million to $5 million during the Community Advisory Committee process.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/gaming-facility-location-board-final-report-and-findings-march-2026

c4: “Confirming that the $5 million annually is for all NYPD associated needs in conjunction with the NYPD substation we will house.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-response-memo-baly-response-9.27.2025.pdf

c5: “Bally’s has agreed to dedicate $5 million annually for NYPD overtime or Paid Detail programs.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-response-memo-baly-response-9.27.2025.pdf

c6: “Yes, we will host an NYPD substation within the property.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/cac-response-memo-baly-response-9.27.2025.pdf

c7: “Upon awarding of a license we will explore and define the appropriate methodology for providing the financial support for all Community Benefit Fund and associated commitments related to the above commitments.”
https://nycasinos.ny.gov/system/files/documents/2025/09/ballys-amendment-to-rfa-response-form_september-28-2025.pdf
